periods.summary: Sara appears openly at the Seven Stars banquet despite Akatsuki's recent attack on Hagun. She ignores politics and focuses on Ikki's body as her ideal subject, tearing his shirt and trying to force him to pose nude. Shizuku knocks her out. Rinna warns Ikki not to underestimate Sara because her art can supplant reality even if Sara herself is physically fragile and accident-prone.

key_events.summary: Harasses Ikki as a model and is removed after Shizuku kicks her.

periods.label: 染血达文西展露真身

name.jp: サラ・ブラッドリリー

periods.affiliation: Akatsuki Academy; Rebellion / 解放军; formerly Rokuzon Academy

status.current: defeats Kurando in C-block second round and becomes Ikki's likely same-day next opponent

personality.summary: An obsessive artist who treats everything, including battle and bodies, as material for art; when blocked from her desired subject she becomes lethally impatient.
fears: wasting time that could be spent studying Ikki

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Obsessed with painting his nude body and later creates combat copies of him, including Ittou Shura users.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Romantic rival nuisance; bribes Stella with a promised royal wedding portrait to gain access to Ikki as a model.
relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Akatsuki teammate who earlier warned Ikki not to underestimate Sara.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Second-round opponent; she dismisses him as an obstacle and defeats him with copied Ikkis.

periods.summary: Sara intrudes into Ikki's hotel room through a drawn door in the wall to demand he pose nude, revealing that her public artist identity is the famous Mario Rosso. Stella initially defends Ikki but is almost bribed by Sara's offer to paint a royal wedding portrait. In the C-block second round Sara reveals the full scale of her abilities. Beyond color concepts such as water, flame, guidance and steel, her Demiurge Brush can actualize drawings as weapons, missiles, armies and even Blazer copies. Kurando's new skill forces her to escalate, but she ultimately draws Ikki copies using Ittou Shura; when Kurando destroys one, more copies impale him. The match proves Sara is far above her nominal C rank, likely A-class in combat value, and creates severe pressure for Ikki's same-day tournament path.

key_events.summary: Interrupts Ikki and Stella by demanding Ikki become her nude model.
Defeats Kurando using Color Magic, Phantasmal Caricature and copied Ikkis.

periods.time: Second-day afternoon through C-block third-round match
periods.label: 染血达文西以画家灵魂挑战无冕剑王

name.jp: サラ・ブラッドリリー

periods.affiliation: Akatsuki Academy; Rebellion by transactional debt; Kazamatsuri family by adoption ties

status.current: loses the third round to Ikki but refuses to truly abandon her artistic obsession
status.condition: physically frail, dependent on prior surgery to move and paint; emotionally awakened by a serious duel
status.goal: complete her father's unfinished Armageddon painting using Ikki as the Messiah model

personality.summary: Monomaniacal, socially shameless and physically weak, yet sincerely devoted to art and capable of deep maternal gentleness.
values: repaying love to her father in her own one-sided way

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Desired model and third-round opponent; she bets her right to pursue him on victory, learns from his resistance, and later ignores the promise not to chase him again.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Ikki's lover and jealous protector; Stella restrains her, forces her to buy proper clothes and witnesses her maternal side.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Stylist for the shopping trip; he recognizes she lacks Rebellion's foul malice and teaches her cosmetics/clothes.
relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Nominal sister through Kazamatsuri Kozo's guardianship; Rinna watches her match with Stella.
relationships.charlotte-corday: Rinna's maid, also observing the match from Akatsuki's side.
relationships.edelweiss: Model for Sara's strongest copy; Sara observed the real Edelweiss and paints a near-perfect but soulless phantom.
relationships.sara-father-mario-rosso: Her deceased father, a failed painter whose unfinished work becomes Sara's life purpose and whose face she gives to her final soul-image.

periods.summary: Sara continues stalking Ikki as the ideal nude model for the central Messiah in her father's unfinished painting. Stella catches her trying to undress Ikki in the infirmary, and Sara explains that completing the painting is as serious to her as the tournament is to knights. Because her apron tears, Stella and Ikki drag her shopping with Alice and Shizuku; Alice styles her into a deliberately sexy but secure outfit, and Sara explains she joined Rebellion only transactionally for surgery and travel access. At the lost-child center, she calmly comforts a teleporting infant by imitating nursing and singing an Italian lullaby, revealing unexpected maternal warmth. She later tells Ikki her childhood story: illness, a father who never turned away from his painting, hatred of art, then the decision to complete the painting as her only filial act and as a challenge to the heat of his art. In the third-round match she fights seriously for the first time, using Color of Magic, Necro Battalion, a copied Edelweiss, copied Ikkis and finally Mario Rosso, a giant bloodied swordsman that embodies her own artistic soul and bears her father's remembered face. Ikki defeats her, but she refuses to truly obey the condition to stop pursuing his model, because she is her stubborn father's daughter.

key_events.summary: Appears during the infirmary aftermath and gives early hints about Ikki's father problem.
Is styled by Alice and later reveals her father, illness and unfinished painting.
Comforts the lost teleporting infant with calm observation and an Italian lullaby.
Fights Ikki seriously with Fantasia Art and loses after exhausting her strongest images.

name.jp: サラ・ブラッドリリー

status.current: observes the final hidden by Color Magic

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former opponent and model of interest; she congratulates him after the final.
relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Companion she helps conceal near the venue.
relationships.edelweiss: Acquaintance who arrives to watch the final.

periods.summary: Sara uses Color Magic to hide herself, Rinna, Charlotte and Tsukikage at a cafe near the venue. She notices Edelweiss approaching and later watches the final, sketching the duel until she asks Edelweiss about the meaning of Ikki and Stella no longer matching. After Ikki wins, she quietly congratulates him.

key_events.summary: Conceals the group and identifies Edelweiss's arrival.
Reacts from the Akatsuki side after Ikki's victory.

status.condition: physically weak and uncomfortable under Kiriko's examination

periods.summary: Sara attends Ikki's post-tournament celebration despite being an Akatsuki-associated former opponent. During the party, Kiriko gets drunk and clings to Sara, commenting on her weak muscles and proposing experimental research to convert fat into muscle, leaving Sara helplessly asking for rescue. Sara's presence also prompts jokes about drawing a missing bathhouse Mount Fuji mural later in the chapter.

key_events.summary: Appears at the party and becomes Kiriko's unwilling target.

periods.label: 试图警告一辉的莎拉

name.jp: サラ・ブラッドリリー

status.current: at ruined Rebellion headquarters when communications fail

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Adoptive younger sister figure accompanying her.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Has his phone number and tries to warn him when she realizes he may be in Vermillion.

periods.summary: Sara accompanies Rinna and Charlotte to the devastated Rebellion headquarters. The massacre's resemblance to a conflict zone darkens her mood. After Tsukikage reveals Or-Gaule's plan to destroy Vermillion and Quedland, Rinna remembers that Ikki and Stella planned to visit Vermillion, and Sara immediately tries to call Ikki because she has his number. The call cannot connect, emphasizing that communications have already been disrupted before SCION arrives.

key_events.summary: Attempts to call Ikki after learning Or-Gaule is targeting Vermillion and Quedland.

abilities: knight ability not foregrounded in this volume segment

periods.label: 以画笔备战PSYON的莎拉

name.jp: サラ・ブラッドリリー

status.current: stands down at Kozo's order when Abraham Carter arrives
status.condition: ready to use her Device but outmatched
status.goal: protect Kozo and Tsukikage if necessary

personality.summary: Quietly ready for combat, responding to crisis by invoking her artistic Device.

relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: Protected person who orders her to stand down.
relationships.abraham-carter: Threat whose arrival overwhelms their defensive posture.

periods.summary: Sara appears in the epilogue at the ruined Rebellion headquarters. When PSYON troops descend and Rinna calls for protection of their fathers, Sara invokes her Device, Demiurge's Brush, preparing to fight. Kozo Kazamatsuri immediately stops her, Rinna and Charlotte because Abraham Carter has arrived and is beyond their ability to defeat. Sara therefore remains a poised but restrained defender during Abraham's demand that Kozo and Tsukikage choose a side in the new post-Rebellion world order.

key_events.summary: Summons Demiurge's Brush but is ordered not to fight Abraham.

periods.label: 以道旁之岩灰留下求救线索

name.jp: サラ・ブラッドリリー

status.current: rescued with Rinna and the others after the Tatra base escape

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Adoptive sister-like mistress; Sara accepts Rinna's order to endure torture together.
relationships.charlotte-corday: Hides Charlotte with Roadside Ash, enabling her to call Ouma.
relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: Adoptive guardian who is pressured through Sara's suffering.
relationships.carl-arlanz: Former benefactor who once treated her illness but now uses her as torture leverage.

periods.summary: Sara accompanies Kazamatsuri's party to the Tyrant's throne room and sees the frozen corpse for the first time. When PSYON captures the group, she uses Roadside Ash to make Charlotte fade from notice, creating the chance for a rescue message. In the Tatra base, Arlanz has Sara and Rinna stripped, bound and burned with fantasy-form pyrokinesis to force Kazamatsuri and Tsukikage to cooperate. Sara resolves to repay the Kazamatsuri family but collapses under the torture. Ouma later finds her unconscious during the rescue.

key_events.summary: Witnesses the Tyrant's corpse and hides Charlotte before PSYON removes the captives.
Is tortured alongside Rinna as leverage against the adults.
Is discovered unconscious when Ouma's battle breaks into the holding area.
